assumptions.choice: size = int(available_cash / current_close_price) at the signal bar, applied on every new long/short entry
assumptions.reason: spec states '100% of available capital per trade' but gives no exact formula; using cash divided by the confirming close price is the most literal reading, with no extra margin buffer since none is specified

assumptions.choice: on a reverse cross that closes an open position, do not also open the opposite position on the same bar; a new entry can only be evaluated once the position is flat
assumptions.reason: canonical default requires holding at most one position at a time with no pyramiding/re-entry while a position is open; the spec does not explicitly request an immediate flip, so the guarded, sequential exit-then-entry check is applied

assumptions.choice: single self.order attribute reset on Completed/Canceled/Margin/Rejected in notify_order, blocking new signal evaluation while an order is pending
rely on backtrader's automatic minperiod (effectively 52 bars) with no manual bar-skipping
assumptions.reason: spec is silent on warm-up handling; canonical default applies
